remarks: Welcome to 1 Maplewood Avenue-Your Opportunity to Call Westport Home! Charming, stylish, and filled with possibilities, this inviting **2-3 bedroom Westport home** offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities and its **highly regarded school system**. Step inside to discover **beautifully refinished hardwood floors** and a bright, comfortable floor plan designed for today's lifestyle. The **updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances**, while refreshed **tile bathrooms** add a clean, modern touch.  Need more room? You'll love the versatility of the **finished walk-up attic**, perfect for a home office, creative studio, guest space, or additional retreat. A separate **playroom** provides even more flexibility for recreation, entertaining, or everyday living. Situated on a corner lot with generous parking, the property offers space, convenience, and plenty of potential to make it your own. Whether you're purchasing your **first home, downsizing, or looking for an exciting opportunity to enter the Westport market**, 1 Maplewood Avenue delivers the perfect combination of charm, updates, flexible living space, and location.  Westport living may be more attainable than you think-come discover the possibilities at 1 Maplewood Avenue!
